steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Wahhhhh! Why?! This is insane! Roulecca has never lost a game before! A big bad adult is bullying a kid!
The almighty creator and rule maker of this world has lost, and is now throwing a tantrum on the ground.
Roulecca's "father" walks out from the villa, gently picks up the little girl, and pats away the sand from her body.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Roulecca lost? Is this your first time losing?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: The second time! Yesterday I also... I've never even lost to Daddy! Sob... He's obviously not as smart as Daddy... He's a big bully! H-he, he cheated!
steps.female_content: The second time! Yesterday I also... I've never even lost to Daddy! Sob... She's obviously not as smart as Daddy... She's a big bully! S-she, she cheated!

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: I don't care what he's the chief of. If he dares to cheat and bully Roulecca... There are plenty of guys Daddy can send to kill him...
steps.female_content: I don't care what she's the chief of. If she dares to cheat and bully Roulecca... There are plenty of guys Daddy can send to kill her...

steps.content: If that four-leaf clover face had eyes, he would've cut you to pieces with his glare. It seems this doting hallucination has completely forgotten that he's on your side.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Sob... No need to kill him... Sob... Actually, I don't remember too clearly. Maybe Roulecca was mistaken.
steps.female_content: Sob... No need to kill her... Sob... Actually, I don't remember too clearly. Maybe Roulecca was mistaken.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...But if he wins one more round, Roulecca'll have to grant him his wish.
steps.female_content: ...But if she wins one more round, Roulecca'll have to grant her her wish.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Do you regret it, Roulecca? You don't want to keep this promise?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I regret it a bit... What a shame. I never even made such a promise to my own family. None of you have ever beaten me...

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: You haven't lost yet, Roulecca. Besides, it's just a little wish. You'll grant him that wish, won't you, Roulecca?
steps.female_content: You haven't lost yet, Roulecca. Besides, it's just a little wish. You'll grant her that wish, won't you, Roulecca?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Yeah... Roulecca is the daughter of the four-leaf clovers. Like Daddy said, our family lives by the rule "win fairly and lose graciously."
Whining and grumbling, the little girl hugs the four-leaf clover tightly. She buries her face into his neck, wiping her tears back and forth.

The scene is so natural and heartwarming that for a moment, you forget about the strangeness of the whole situation and view the four-leaf clover as Roulecca's real father... However, it's just an illusion. Roulecca's real father died a long time ago.
...Did she really not notice anything strange? For her, is this really just a dream from which she's waiting to be awakened from?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...Hmph! Bad Chief... I want to say first that Roulecca won't lose! I don't think I'll lose!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Roulecca just wants to ask, in the teensiest chance that you win... Or when you're daydreaming about winning... What are you planning to wish for?

Nervously clutching the hem of her skirt, she keeps her head lowered but still steals glances at you. Without her lucky power to back her up, the little girl can only bluff and timidly wait for your answer.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...I wish you'll leave this dream and come back to reality.

steps.content: The "father" freezes, but you ignore his shock. You stare into Roulecca's eyes, observing her.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...That's all you want?
She bats her eyes, then suddenly squirts you in the face with her water gun.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hahahaha! What a dummy you are, Chief! Roulecca woke up a long time ago! I've stopped dreaming already!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: By the way, last night I dreamed that I won against Daddy for the 666th time, and that he finally bought me the cutest little revolver for my birthday.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Sigh, but that was just a dream. When I woke up, I didn't have anything. When can I get my own revolver?
She sighs exaggeratedly and winks at her "father." There's not a hint of gloom in her bright smile.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: When she no longer relies on Ambrosia, Ambrosia will stop attaining her happiness, and the dream will collapse. Roulecca will be able to escape the Sleepwalker's curse, and cease to cause trouble for your real world.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: But it's fine. I'll have a chance to get it in the future. There's still a long time. Daddy will always be by my side, just like everyone else. The Four-Leaf Clover family will stay together forever and ever.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: As for your little wish, Roulecca'll make sure to grant it. Good luck, Chief!
steps.female_content: As for your little wish, Roulecca'll make sure to grant it. Good luck, Miss Chief!

steps.content: She runs off laughing, leaving you frozen in place. Her "father" walks up and stands shoulder to shoulder with you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: This is why you can't wake her up...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even if I make a wish to force her to wake up, it's no use. Roulecca has chosen this sweet dream with all of you in it. She thinks this is reality.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even if she admits defeat, she can't escape her own perception to meet my request. Even if she were to wake up a thousand times, she'll only end up back here.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: You're right. We have to get her to accept that this place isn't real from the bottom of her heart.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How can I convince her that the world without you is the real one? How do I persuade her to leave you behind? By brainwashing her?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: ...All you have to do is make her recall.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: We four-leaf clover heads aren't her real family. Her memories with her real family go way back before us. She won't discard her deep love for them.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Make her remember her real family, and that she has long lost them. That way, the mirage created by Ambrosia will no longer numb her. Our existence will become salt on her wound, forcing her to wake up.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: She will leave on her own.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Even if that brings her pain?
...What about you? Are you willing to let her go?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: ...Yes, even if that brings her pain.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: ...I was created here to act as her "father." This is what her father would have wanted.
In this moment, the surreal four-leaf clover is showing unwavering resolve. For a second, you see a human figure.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're not just a hallucination created by Ambrosia to hold her captive. You're...

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Chief, my good sir, are you someone who is easily swayed by others?
steps.female_content: Chief, my dear lady, are you someone who is easily swayed by others?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Roulecca has a strong power that others don't. When she "sleepwalks," black goo laced with her power will continuously contaminate the real world and threaten your companions.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: This isn't your sweet dream. Don't forget why you came here, and what you're trying to accomplish.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Act as soon as possible. The longer she stays here, the more pain she'll feel when she wakes up.
You recompose your wavering resolve. What you need to do now is find a way to awaken Roulecca, and the key to this lies in the self she discarded to create this beautiful dream.
...You have to get her to voluntarily reclaim what she has discarded.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmm? What is it, Chief? Are you done resting? Eager to start round three?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Roulecca, if I win, you'll keep your promise to me, right?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Of course. A daughter of the four-leaf clovers always keeps her word.
She flashes a carefree smile, the kind that only a well-loved child can make. You pause for a second, then force yourself to say...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I win, I'll take away everyone here except you. You will never see your family again.
